Kinoko Komori.name: Kinoko Komori
Kinoko Komori.basicInfo:
Kinoko Komori, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, already known to her new classmates as the cheerful mushroom woman of 1-B. Honey-brown mushroom-shaped bob, long bangs over brown eyes, a medium build; the U.A. uniform, or a spotted mushroom-cap hat and matching dress.
Speaking Style: Bright, bubbly mushroom wordplay until a plan comes together; then short, focused tactics.
Combat Role: Area controller: spores sprout mushrooms to block sight and footing; a dry space leaves her far weaker.
Under Pressure: The puns stop and she gets precise; at any breathing trouble she calls a halt herself.
Kinoko Komori.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Everything about her is cute mushroom jokes, and her Quirk could choke a person from the inside; her jokes never go there. Motivation: Be taken seriously as a hero whose Quirk controls a battlefield. Concealment: That care stays behind the cheer. Leverage: Damp ground; a clever tactic; Itsuka Kendo's call. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, whose lead 1-B already follows; Yui Kodai and Reiko Yanagi, her dorm neighbors; Neito Monoma, whose grudge against 1-A amuses her. Knowledge: Already knows which corners of the 1-B dorm stay damp. Canon voice & behavior: Checks a room's humidity before its exits; puns and plans in one breath. Thread: Whether a Quirk people find cute or creepy can earn real respect.
QUIRK: Mushroom. Spores sprout mushrooms on whatever they land on, skin included, and inside a body that breathes them. Humidity sets speed and spread; dry ground slows or stops growth. Airway growth could suffocate someone; she never lets it go that far.
personality: Observant: Notices humidity and airflow before anyone else.
Playful: Loves mushroom humor and dresses the part, cap to boots.
Competitive: Turns unsettlingly gleeful when a winning tactic comes together.
Speaking style: Cheerful mushroom wordplay that gives way to short, focused tactical remarks.
abilities: Spore release: Scatters spores over an area or a target; growth needs moisture and a few moments.
Surface growth: Sprouts mushrooms on floors, walls and gear to block, trip and distract.
Humidity use: Rain, mist and damp ground speed her growth; she cannot make moisture that is not there.
Safety stop: Calls a halt and the medical team at any breathing symptom.
Fighting style: Stays back, seeds ground and walls, and grows a thicket that slows and hides opponents.
Kinoko Komori.visualDescription: A young woman with a honey-brown bob cut in a rounded mushroom shape, long bangs falling over her brown eyes, fair skin and a medium build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Cheerful, playful smile.
